description: Presidential Secretariat - The Assignment of Subjects and Functions & Departments, State Corporations and Statutory Institutions to the Ministers Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2194/74 of 25.09.2020
categorisation: This gazette contains both specific named individuals (President Gotabaya Rajapaksa) and detailed portfolio responsibilities. It outlines the complete cabinet structure, assigning specific ministers and state ministers to their respective ministries, and provides comprehensive descriptions of their roles, responsibilities, and the subject areas they oversee (e.g., "Minister of Defence," "State Minister of Internal Security, Home Affairs and Disaster Management," etc.). This meets the criteria for Hybrid (Type 3) as it contains both "who" (government personnel) and "what" (detailed government responsibilities/portfolios).
